title: The Language of Room 214
author: L. M. Yarrow
blurb: Theo Delacroix, a bridge inspector measuring the marriage in expansion joints, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. Then the last speaker of a language asks for one final student — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around before the last bus to the old neighborhood is rerouted forever.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
